name: Ferrante (Ferdinando) Maletta
bioAdditions: Ferdinando married Isabella Moraca on 5 June 1695 (S1). Their daughter Anna Maria was born in 1692, before the indexed marriage date. The index date or the child's identification should be checked on the image. A daughter Francesca Giovanna died as a child in December 1702.
